summary: Underfoot is the divine subterranean realm of Brell Serilis. It is the metaphysical foundation beneath all worlds, a labyrinth of stone, crystal, magma, and divine craftsmanship.

events: Underfoot formed as the first subterranean realm.
Brell Serilis shaped the caverns, roots, and molten forges.
Brell created the first stone guardians.
Crystal roots spread into other planes.
The Throne of Brell became accessible.
